import json, signal, subprocess, time
from datetime import UTC, datetime
signal.alarm(20)
commands = [
    ["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=name,uuid,memory.total,memory.used,utilization.gpu", "--format=csv,noheader,nounits"],
    ["nvidia-smi", "--query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory", "--format=csv,noheader,nounits"],
]
samples = []
for repeat in range(4):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    queries = []
    for command in commands:
        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5, check=False)
        queries.append({"command":command,"exit_code":result.returncode,"stdout":result.stdout,"stderr":result.stderr})
    samples.append({"repeat":repeat,"seconds":time.perf_counter()-start,"queries":queries})
print(json.dumps({"utc":datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),"samples":samples,"scope":"Read-only ownership-query timing; no framework/model/allocation/job"}))
